{{Top|leg}}
An '''antiseptic irrigation bulb''' was a standard medical tool that was used to clean wounds and prevent infections. They were used in conjunction with [[disinfectant pad]]s. Antiseptic irrigation bulbs could be found as standard equipment in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
